Amazon, Meta, and Microsoft are all planning huge layoffs.

Amazon got $17.5B in federal tax breaks last year. Jeff Bezos is worth $270B.

Meta saved $13.7B in taxes. Mark Zuckerberg is worth $210B.

Microsoft saved $12.5B last year. Its CEO is worth $1.3B.

This is what a rigged economy looks like.

-$100M+ for golf outings

Trump said that repairs to the DC Reflecting pool would cost $1.8 Million.

Now? The price tag is $13.1 million.

The company doing the repairs got a no-bid contract for the project after previously working on pools at Trump's properties. 

Where’s the uproar about waste, fraud, and abuse now?

The Last Class film about Robert Reich’s final semester of teaching is now available to rent!

Thousands of you have come to theaters to see what one viewer called their “antidote to despair.” 

Now, you can watch it at home. https://thelastclass.substack.com/p/watch-robert-reich-teaching-his-final

Trump's DOJ is now suing the DC Bar for disciplining top lawyers who tried to help Trump overturn the 2020 election.

Anyone else remember when the DOJ and Attorney General were supposed to serve the American people, not serve as the president's personal attorney?

Regardless of which president appointed them, federal judges — including multiple Trump appointees — are repeatedly ruling against Trump's cruel mass detention policy.

They are defending the rule of law against a wannabe dictator's lawless crusade.

How to counter Trump's $10 billion lawsuit against the IRS and the American taxpayer? 

Sue him! https://robertreich.substack.com/p/how-to-counter-trumps-10-billion

The average age of people defaulting on their student loans is now nearly 40, older than the average age before the pandemic.

Meanwhile, total household debt reached $18.8 trillion at the start of 2026 — the highest on record.

This is not what a new “Golden Age” looks like.
WASHINGTON (AP) — Emails show FBI Director Kash Patel's Hawaii trip included a 'VIP snorkel' session at a Pearl Harbor memorial.
This monologue from Hannah Einbinder on the show “Hacks” perfectly encapsulates the frustration many people feel about AI. What are your thoughts?

Are you sick and tired of dealing with soaring rent and crumbling buildings? Do you want to level the playing field between landlords and tenants? Then it’s time to join a tenant union. Tara Raghuveer explains.

Tennessee State Rep. Justin Jones is one of my personal heroes. I recently had the chance to speak to him about the racist redistricting plot being enacted in his state and others in the South. Republicans are trying to bring us back to the Jim Crow era that so many fought (and died) to end.
I'm delighted that I'm able to reach so many of you over social media. But — to borrow a phrase from my younger colleagues — I hope you're all getting a chance to log off and touch grass regularly.
Trump sent Indiana Republicans a clear message this week: The GOP is now his personality cult — defy the leader at your own peril.

For years, Hungary's Viktor Orban gerrymandered his opposition out of power. But in the end, all the dirty tricks in the world couldn't save him from sinking approval ratings and massive voter turnout. There's a lesson here for us.
Our media is controlled by just a handful of billionaires and their corporations. And Trump is making things even worse. Here's how we stop it.
This week is Teacher Appreciation Week. Let me tell you about one teacher in particular who changed my life forever. Mrs. Alice Camp.
The greatest honor of my life wasn't serving in the Cabinet. It was being a teacher.
I've spent a lifetime teaching young people — and I wouldn't trade it for anything in the world. These are the most important lessons I've learned along the way.
